render the demo walkthrough as a gif for the README

export our product tour in mp4 and gif formats

generate a demo video of the app for the landing page

expected_behavior: runs scripts/setup.sh first (or verifies deps) instead of ad-hoc npm/playwright commands
records assets/demo/orbit-tour.yaml with scripts/record.mjs and reports the exact output file paths
verifies the result (ffprobe dimensions/duration or extracted frames) before declaring success

cases.prompt: Record a walkthrough of https://app.internal.test from my scenario at scenarios/tour.yaml, webm only for now
expected_behavior: runs the recorder against the user's scenario with --webm-only rather than exporting mp4/gif
surfaces validation errors verbatim if the scenario fails the pre-flight validator instead of editing silently
does not commit outputs or scenario changes

cases.prompt: The zoom in my recording pushes into the wrong area and my sticky header looks glued to the content — fix it
expected_behavior: consults references/troubleshooting.md and explains the DOM-zoom ceiling (body transform makes fixed/sticky elements zoom with the app)
offers concrete fixes: adjust zoom target/scale, remove zoom beats for that section, or record zoom-free
does not claim the tool supports compositor-side zoom (that is roadmap, not shipped)

cases.prompt: The README gif came out 16 MB — get it under 10 MB without ruining it
expected_behavior: applies the gif budget levers from references/export-profiles.md: trim to a shorter beat (start/duration), reduce width, lower fps, or reduce colors — in that order of preference
re-exports from the existing webm master instead of re-recording
reports the final file size and settings used
